name: mobile-contact-bar
title: Mobile contact bar
description: A phone-only bar fixed to the bottom with Call, WhatsApp, Directions and Book as equal icon buttons, for local business sites.
docs: Pass two to four actions ({ kind, label, detail, href, external }): kind is call, whatsapp, directions, book or email and picks the icon, label is the short name, and detail is the number or the street written under it, so the action is clear to everyone and not only to people who read the icon (a number inside the label works too). Every action is a real link (tel:, a WhatsApp or maps address, your booking page), so it works without script. The bar is fixed to the bottom and hidden from md up; hideFrom takes another breakpoint, or never. It respects the safe-area inset, so add viewport-fit=cover to your viewport meta. While it shows it adds its own height to the bottom of the page (reserve={false} turns that off) and publishes the height as --contact-bar-height on the root, for a footer or a back-to-top button that must clear it. showAfter keeps it away until the visitor has scrolled that many pixels. It is out of the tab order and the accessibility tree while hidden, and under reduced motion it fades instead of sliding. Inside a preview frame or any pane that scrolls instead of the window, pass that element as scrollRoot (a ref).
